title: New Jersey's 8th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: New Jersey's 8th Congressional District, covering parts of Essex, Hudson, and Union counties including Newark, Jersey City, Hoboken, and Elizabeth, is holding a general election for the U.S. House of Representatives on November 3, 2026. Incumbent Democrat Rob Menendez, first elected in 2022 and son of former U.S. Senator Bob Menendez, won a competitive primary against Mussab Ali on June 2, 2026. No Republican candidate qualified for the ballot, leading GOP county chairs to back independent candidate Aristotle Eliopoulos, a teacher and union official. The district is heavily Democratic with a 52% Democratic voter registration advantage. Also on the ballot are Socialist Workers Party candidate Craig Honts and independent Da'Shone Hughey.
polling_note: No recent public opinion polls specific to the NJ-08 general election matchup were found as of mid-2026. The district is rated Safe/Solid Democratic by major nonpartisan forecasters including Cook Political Report, Inside Elections, and Sabato's Crystal Ball.

candidates.name: Rob Menendez
candidates.summary: Rob Menendez (Robert Menendez Jr.) is the incumbent U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 8th Congressional District, first elected in 2022. A former Port Authority commissioner and attorney, he serves on the House Transportation and Infrastructure and Homeland Security committees. Menendez won his 2026 primary with approximately 68.8% of the vote against challenger Mussab Ali.

candidates.name: Aristotle Eliopoulos
candidates.summary: Aristotle 'Ari' Eliopoulos is an independent candidate running for New Jersey's 8th Congressional District with the backing of Republican county chairs in Hudson, Essex, and Union counties after no Republican candidate qualified for the primary ballot. He is a teacher, union representative, and son of Greek immigrant parents who owned a small business in Jersey City. His campaign platform focuses on education, special needs advocacy, lowering the cost of living, housing affordability, and public safety.

forecast.rationale: NJ-08 is a heavily Democratic district with a 52-point Democratic voter registration advantage. No Republican candidate qualified for the primary ballot; instead, GOP county chairs are backing independent Aristotle Eliopoulos, a teacher and union official. Incumbent Democrat Rob Menendez won his June 2026 primary decisively with ~68.8% of the vote. All major nonpartisan forecasters (Cook, Inside Elections, Sabato's) rate the seat Safe/Solid Democratic. While there is no district-specific general election polling, the structural fundamentals overwhelmingly favor the Democratic incumbent. The independent and third-party candidates (Eliopoulos, Honts, Hughey) face severe headwinds in a district where Democrats hold a voter registration advantage of more than 2-to-1. The most likely outcome is a comfortable Democratic hold in the 30+ point margin range.
